Name: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited
Description:
Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) is one of India’s leading renewable energy companies, driving the transition towards a cleaner, more resilient and sustainable energy future. 

As a subsidiary of Tata Power Company Limited, TPREL delivers integrated green energy solutions across solar, wind, hybrid, round-the-clock (RTC), peak power, floating solar and energy storage technologies. With capabilities spanning project development, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and maintenance, the company plays a pivotal role across the renewable energy value chain.
Today, TPREL has a renewable utility portfolio of 11.6 GW, including 6.7 GW of operational capacity comprising solar and wind assets, and 4.9 GW under implementation. The company has also established the country's largest single-location integrated solar cell and module manufacturing facility in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, with a capacity of 4.3 GW.
Beyond utility-scale renewable projects, TPREL's integrated offerings span rooftop solar, distributed energy solutions, EV charging infrastructure and advisory services, enabling businesses, institutions and communities to accelerate their sustainability journeys.

With a solar EPC portfolio exceeding 16.8 GWp and around 5.1 GWp of rooftop and distributed installations, TPREL continues to support India's growing clean energy ambitions through innovation, scale and execution excellence.

As India advances towards a cleaner energy future, TPREL remains committed to enabling energy access at scale through integrated green energy solutions. Guided by innovation, responsibility and sustainable growth, we are helping build a future powered by clean energy and shared progress.

Our newly designed 2 axis technology (designed in collaboration with IIT Delhi) has two movements on hourly/daily basis, i) East to West with ± 45°.  ii) North to South with + 50° towards south and − 10° towards North. With these flexibilities in movements the tracker makes the angle of incidence of sun radiation on solar PV module close to perpendicular position at all times. Hence addresses both the solstice and equinox periods in a year. 

This technology is an enhanced and completely new technology, which replaces and disrupts existing Single Axis Tracking technology, hence rendering it obsolete. It is designed to succeed similar technology that is already in use. It is a Next Generation solar tracker, which offers the yield close to Dual Axis tracker at a cost of Single Axis tracker. Hence, making it most economically viable tracking technology in the world.

Kanoda Energy Systems Pvt. Ltd. is a technology and innovation-driven renewable energy enterprise.  Our mission is to power the transition to Energy 2.0.  We aspire to make renewable energy the rule rather than the exception.

With renewables entering the realm of economic viability, there are still several fundamental shifts required to realize their full potential.  Today legacy systems dominate not only in terms of technology, but also within mind-sets.  It is time we go back to the drawing board, and start implementing leapfrog strategies to outpace our mounting environmental concerns.

Kanoda’s vision is to mainstream renewables using agile technologies delivered by value-driven competencies.  We see a paradigm shift.

The proportion of solar and wind have to increase in our energy mix.  Infirm renewable generation will have to be balanced with energy storage and demand response initiatives.  Electric vehicles will demand accommodation in the electricity grid.  Transportation will be smarter addressing congestion and last-mile connectivity issues.  The grid will transform into clusters of smarter micro-grids to become more resilient.

Consumers will be more aware and informed, and will participate in dynamic electricity markets.  Electricity distribution will be more socialized, and existing business models of utilities will change.  Policies and regulations will have to keep up.

Kanoda was a modest start-up by a couple of research scholars at Georgia Tech, but with a generous dream.  Today, Kanoda boasts of a workforce that has played an active role in establishing over 1,500 MW of solar capacities, trained over 1,500 professionals & technicians, and helped shape major renewable policies and initiatives throughout India.

At the core of Avan Tech's mission is its flagship invention, Jalraksha – India’s first patented automatic water level controller with a submersible starter. Jalraksha is an electromechanical solution that conserves significant amounts of underground water and electricity by preventing overflow and dry-run conditions in water tanks. It is widely applicable in homes, schools, hospitals, industries, public buildings, and transport hubs like railway stations and RTC complexes.

Jalraksha has demonstrated the ability to save 1.314 billion liters of water, 6.57 million kWh of electricity, and reduce 5.39 million kg of CO2 emissions over six years with just 2,000 units installed. The innovation is being implemented as a pilot project under AMRUT 2.0, initiated by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Government of India, starting with Srikakulam Municipality, with plans to expand to more cities and towns across the country.

The company is driven by a strong focus on Research & Development (R&D), Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), and Commercialization. Avan Tech holds multiple Indian and international patents, including a patent granted in Japan, and has technologies that reduce up to 50% of plastic usage.

Avan Tech Innovation has received five National Awards and one International Award from prestigious bodies such as:

    Action for India

Over the long term, RSOLEC intends to expand its manufacturing over the entire solar value chain.

RSOLEC's product is high quality silicon wafer with low oxygen, high lifetime, and controlled resistivity, compatible with all solar cell technologies, including TOPCon, PERC, HJT, and Tandem structures. There is a clear path to growing crystals with uniform resistivity, which can increase the cell efficiency by 0.15%, which has not been accomplished in solar manufacturing so far. For select customers desiring very low oxygen content, Magnetic Czochralski (MCZ) platform will be used. The plant will be capable of producing wafers of various sizes, including M10, G12, and G16.

Our clients wanted to have reliable power both in day and night. With solar mainly providing power in the daytime and wind providing power at the night time, now clients have power round the clock which reduces the power storage cost. Indian market is very diverse for having different types of regions having varying wind speeds. Therefore, Revayu has launched 6 blade low cut in low RPM wind turbines working on as low as 1.5 m/s wind speed. Even a slight breeze of air will provide enough torque for wind turbine to start producing power. Therefore, increasing the efficiency and availability of the wind turbines. 

Our newly designed hybrid systems can provide reliable source of power for almost 24 hours. In this system we have used foundation less towers with 6 blade wind turbines and solar panels that was installed in record time of just 24 hours. This systems are also best suited for Industrial & residential rooftops. The hybrid systems can be provided in Off Grid & On Grid modes.

Revayu Energy provides power to telecom towers by installing wind turbines at the tower top thus reducing the cost of wind turbine tower ensuring faster ROI for the end telecom client. Existing off grid telecom towers are running on diesel- solar hybrid along with battery systems for storing power. However, with the introduction of wind turbines for telecom towers in high wind potential areas, Revayu Energy is able to eliminate mostly the use of diesel generators.

Our Neutral Electrolyzed water (Hocl) generators produces on-site Eco-friendly cleaning and disinfectant solutions that safely, effectively and naturally combat contagious pathogens.
HydroCleanerTM solutions are aggressive against all viruses, but delicate for the planet.

Neutral Electrolyzed Water (NEW) is an all natural, non-toxic, non-irritant, environmentally and ecologically safe sanitizing and disinfection solution. It is produced from the Electrochemical reaction of water, salt and electricity. This process creates large volumes of gentle but extremely potent antimicrobial solution capable of rapid reduction of bacteria, viruses, spores, cysts, scale and biofilm.
 
SNWI has a unique electrode, a well designed software and technologically proven, full proof machine to deliver 99.99% effective disinfectants for various applications.

Why to use Electrolyzed water as disinfectants???

- NEW is generated on demand and applied when required to eliminate the logistical concerns of purchasing, transportation, storing, preparing and disposal of toxic chemical residues and plastic bottles.
- The elimination of hazardous chemicals translates into reductions in regulatory paperwork, safety training requirements, safety inspections, etc.
- Allows for disinfection of areas where toxic chemicals are not permitted.
- NEW has been demonstrated to be upto 100 times more effective than sodium hypochlorite.   
- Allows for the marketability of a 'clean & hygiene' facility.
- Completely safe, non-harmful, green product using only natural ingredients. (Water, Salt and Electricity)
- The system are all 'plug and play' with little adjustments.
- Eliminates the need for expensive and potentially toxic chemicals. 
- on-site production allows NEW to be produced 24x7 on demand.

Description:
GPR PS PL is an EPC Contractor known for proper scheduling and synchronizing various packages as per detailed design engineering and Quality Standards from DPR till PG Test with contemporary knowledge about the standards adopted in the Power Sector under the Ministry of Power, Ministry of Non Conventional Energy and State Nodal Agencies. The Scope of Service offered include EPC, BOP/MEI (Mechanical, Electrical and Instrumentation) Packages & Solar PV packages across India catering   to all sectors for more than a decade.

Following are the 2 areas where we propose to extend our services:

*Catalytic Hybrid Biomass Power Plant - Referring to India’s vision on achieving Energy independence and power for all by 2022, India is targeting 175GW of renewable energy capacity which is an ambitious target that will require fourfold growth in the sector.  The 2022 target includes 60GW of Wind, 40GW of Solar, 10GW of Biomass and 5GW of small hydro power projects. To achieve the 10GW (10000MW) Biomass power there is a need of clean and green energy.

The technology is based on Catalytic Combustion system in which a hybrid boiler (both water and fire tube) is used for super-heated steam generation. The combustion system is comprising of a pressurized moisture flow having 85% humidity which gets converted into super-heated steam and act as catalyst to generate high temperature, thus saving in Biomass.

The Technology has following uniqueness:
•	Controllable high furnace temperature around 1400 degree Centigrade.
•	Fuel Saving around 40%
•	Smoke free i.e minimum pollution
•	It can burn any type of Biomass
•	Safe
•	Sustainable
•	Low running cost

* Waste to Energy Pyrolysis Plant – The process involves converting waste plastic to fuel oil which can run diesel generator to generate power.  In the present scenario there is scope for setting up about 3000 nos of 5 TPD plants or 1500 nos of 10  TPD. 

Pyrolysis is a Unique and Cost Effective Technology to extract Fuel from Waste Plastics.  It is a completely automatic plant equipped with all control & safety features. The process involves Pyrolysis technology which is thermal degradation process in the absence of oxygen. Plastic waste is treated in a cylindrical chamber at temperature of 370°C - 420°C.  The polymer is gently cracked by adding Catalyst and the pyrolysis gases are condensed in a 
series of condensers to give a low sulphur content distillate .The input required is mixed plastic scrap from which the output obtained will be Fuel Oil and carbon ash.

Midas Touch is a nongovernmental organization founded in 2009 based at Imphal. It mainly focusses on Biodiversity conservation and we firmly believe in greener earth and better living. We aim to create a sustainable livelihood through community participation while simultaneously conserving the biodiversity. Employment generation of the youth and sustainable living are the foremost goal of our organization. The biodiversity of Manipur comprises endemic floral diversity, particularly medicinal plants of importance to pharmaceutical industry, and unique faunal diversity. Nevertheless, it is very unfortunate that this great land of biodiversity is least explored probably due to geographical and political constraints. Different anthropogenic and socio-economic factors have perturbed the pristine ecology of this region, leading to environmental degradation. We argue that effective conservation of biodiversity is essential for human survival and the maintenance of ecosystem processes. Despite some conservation successes (especially at local scales) and increasing public and government interest in living sustainably, biodiversity continues to decline. Successful conservation approaches need to be reinforced and adequately financed. In addition, however, more radical changes are required that recognize biodiversity as a global public good, that integrate biodiversity conservation into policies and decision frameworks for resource production ,consumption ,sustainable agriculture and that focus on wider institutional and societal changes to enable more effective implementation of policy.
Sustainable agriculture using innovation and technology would bring a commendable social changes in this remote state crippled with turmoil and hurdles like economic blockade in National Highways, bandhs paralyzing the state often. Organic farming , climate change, focus on medicinal and aromatic plants along with value added products , traditional knowledge conservation are priority areas.

Description:
Flora naturals Private limited (erstwhile SM Bioleum Resources Private Limited) is a Renewable Energy Engineering company based out of Pune. Flora's promoters have been undertaking research and development activities for past 10 years.

Flora has collaborated with the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), under Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, for joint development of BTL technologies for India. National Chemical Laboratories (NCL), a premier Government of India institution based out of Pune, India, is the principal collaborator representing the CSIR for this joint development effort. This initiative is focused on a novel approach developed by Flora that combines thermo-chemical and bio-chemical routes for conversion of biomass into syngas and then converting it via Fischer-Tropsch (FT) synthesis into ultra-pure transportation fuels such as Gasoline, Diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF). Flora also closely works with a number of national labs, universities and IITs for creating and sharing a knowledge base in the BTL domain.

Along with our partners, we have developed technology to generate, upgrade, store and dispense BioCNG (Bio-methane) as vehicular fuel confirming to all mandatory government standards.  Our objective is to set up a decentralized and distributed network of small commercial BioCNG production and dispensing stations based on Fuel Flexible and Modular Architecture at county (Taluk) level across India.

Our BioCNG plant uses special energy crop Hybrid Napier and Beena Bamboo, apart from other agro-residue as feedstock. India generates sufficiently large amount of agro-residue. Most of the biomass is treated as nuisance and simply burnt away. Ironically, the villages that hold this potential energy source are also suffering from energy shortages. Converting this abundantly available and unutilized biomass resource into energy is, therefore, the need of the hour.

To ensure continuous and guaranteed biomass availability, we also have a separate division focused on Energy Plantations using Napier Grass and Beena Bamboo. This division has gained expertise in planting, harvesting, handling, and pre-processing raw biomass for its further conversion to bio-fuels.

Name: Give Back To Earth
Description: Give Back To Earth is a student run waste management organisation which aims to remedy the improper waste disposal system of our country. According to SAFE (South Asian Forum for Environment), 5372 tonnes of urban municipal solid waste is generated in Kolkata everyday of which 37% is compostable, but not even a tenth of this waste is recycled and most of it is sent to the Dhapa landfill. This waste has only added to the release of harmful pollutants in Kolkata and we at Give Back To Earth have an answer: Composting. We design and manufacture and sell composting equipment to residential societies in the city and also donate it to villages nearby. In its current iteration, our composting machine - named MAATI (Bengali for soil) - consists of two 210-litre cylinders that rotate about a horizontal axis via a gear system. Our specially designed composters give definite solutions to the chief obstacles faced in the process of composting, namely: prolonged periods it takes for each batch of compost to decompose, the foul smell generated by the waste and the large amount of space taken up by the composting equipment. Our machine is specially made airtight with an industrial gasket and has wheels attached to the bottom making it completely mobile. The high speed rotation via the gear system helps in increasing the surface area of the waste by breaking them down thus facilitating speedy composting.

Name: World Solar Research Center

The Institute’s R&D spectrum covers materials, components, processes, systems and services, with an emphasis on solar photovoltaic cells, modules and systems. WSRC is globally active but focuses on technologies and services for tropical regions, in particular for Singapore and South-East Asia.

WSRC multi-disciplinary research team includes more than 140 scientists, engineers, technicians and PhD students. In addition, the institute has formal research links with more than 20 professors from NUS (“Adjunct researchers”).
